headline.title: Factory hits $1.5B valuation to build AI coding for enterprises
headline.summary: A three-year-old startup focused on AI coding for enterprises has achieved a valuation of $1.5 billion after raising $150 million in a funding round led by Khosla Ventures. The investment will support the company's growth and development in the AI sector.

articles.title: Upscale AI in talks to raise at $2B valuation, says report
articles.summary: Upscale AI, an AI infrastructure company, is reportedly negotiating to raise funds at a valuation of $2 billion. This would mark its third funding round since its launch seven months ago.

articles.title: MARS$^2$: Scaling Multi-Agent Tree Search via Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation
articles.summary: The article presents MARS², a novel approach that enhances multi-agent tree search using reinforcement learning to improve code generation tasks. By introducing structured exploration through multiple interacting policies, the method addresses the limitations of single-agent policy priors and enhances trajectory diversity.

articles.title: DR$^{3}$-Eval: Towards Realistic and Reproducible Deep Research Evaluation
articles.summary: The article introduces DR$^{3}$-Eval, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Deep Research Agents (DRAs) on complex tasks involving multimodal understanding and report generation. This evaluation framework addresses challenges posed by dynamic web environments and ambiguous task definitions, aiming for realism and reproducibility in assessments.

articles.title: M2-PALE: A Framework for Explaining Multi-Agent MCTS--Minimax Hybrids via Process Mining and LLMs
articles.summary: The article introduces M2-PALE, a framework designed to enhance the explainability of multi-agent Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and Minimax hybrids by integrating process mining techniques and large language models (LLMs). This framework aims to address the challenges developers and users face in understanding the behavior of MCTS agents within complex decision-making environments.

articles.title: SAGE Celer 2.6 Technical Card
articles.summary: SAGEA has released SAGE Celer 2.6, a new version of its general-purpose Celer models, available in 5B, 10B, and 27B parameter sizes. The model features architectural enhancements and improved pre-training, utilizing an Inverse Reasoning pipeline to reduce errors and hallucinations in complex reasoning tasks.

articles.title: Benchmarking Linguistic Adaptation in Comparable-Sized LLMs: A Study of Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen3-8B on Romanized Nepali
articles.summary: A study benchmarks the linguistic adaptation of three comparable-sized open-weight large language models—Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.1, and Qwen3-8B—specifically for Romanized Nepali, a language underrepresented in digital resources. The evaluation focuses on their performance in zero-shot and few-shot scenarios, highlighting the challenges and potential of these models in processing informal digital communication in Nepal.

articles.title: QU-NLP at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Two-Stage QLoRA Fine-Tuning of Qwen3-4B for Patient-Oriented Clinical Question Answering and Evidence Sentence Alignment
articles.summary: The QU-NLP team introduced a unified system for the ArchEHR-QA Shared Task, focusing on clinical question answering and evidence sentence alignment. They utilized a two-stage QLoRA fine-tuning approach on the Qwen3-4B model, enhancing its performance through training on a large medical dataset and specific annotated cases.

articles.title: MEME-Fusion@CHiPSAL 2026: Multimodal Ablation Study of Hate Detection and Sentiment Analysis on Nepali Memes
articles.summary: The paper presents a system developed for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task, focusing on hate speech detection and sentiment analysis in Devanagari-scripted social media memes. It addresses the challenges of multimodal content, linguistic complexity, and data scarcity in low-resource settings through a hybrid approach for both binary hate speech detection and three-class sentiment classification.

articles.title: ELMoE-3D: Leveraging Intrinsic Elasticity of MoE for Hybrid-Bonding-Enabled Self-Speculative Decoding in On-Premises Serving
articles.summary: The article presents ELMoE-3D, a novel approach that utilizes the intrinsic elasticity of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models to enhance self-speculative decoding in on-premises serving environments. This method addresses the challenges of memory-bound operations and underutilization of compute resources in large-scale language models by optimizing bandwidth and reducing idle compute.

articles.title: Fact4ac at the Financial Misinformation Detection Challenge Task: Reference-Free Financial Misinformation Detection via Fine-Tuning and Few-Shot Prompting of Large Language Models
articles.summary: The paper discusses a winning methodology for the Financial Misinformation Detection Challenge, focusing on reference-free detection of financial misinformation using fine-tuning and few-shot prompting of large language models. It addresses the challenges of identifying misleading narratives in real-world scenarios where external verification is not possible, highlighting the importance of tackling financial misinformation for market stability.

articles.title: AD4AD: Benchmarking Visual Anomaly Detection Models for Safer Autonomous Driving
articles.summary: The article presents AD4AD, a benchmarking framework for evaluating visual anomaly detection models in autonomous driving systems. It emphasizes the importance of training data distribution and highlights the potential risks associated with failures in machine vision systems when encountering atypical obstacles.
